name: Poisoned Water
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A force of elemental scouts was sent to the eastern plaguelands of Lordaeron, and the disease of that place twisted and infected them.  The Waterlords cannot allow this affront to our purity!

Take this vial.  In it is a quantity of one aspect of Neptulon.  If used on the plagued elementals it will fight the poison within their bodies and cure them!  But their inner conflict will drive them into a surging madness.

Defeat the discordant surges and bring me their bracers of binding.
narrative.objectives: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands.  Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have done well, Champion. The corrupted elementals you cured were an outrage to all bodies of water. Our strength lies in our purity and if we are to win our war with the others, we must remain strong.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 56 to 60, 52,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Poisoned Water
quests.objectiveText: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Eye of the Emberseer
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: The Molten Core
quests.objectiveText: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Agent of Hydraxis
quests.objectiveText: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: Hands of the Enemy
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

quests.name: A Hero's Reward
quests.objectiveText: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.
